run_microbenchmarks: run opt and counters microbenchmarks with configurable loops and save json output
run_benchmarks_with_regex_filter: run microbenchmarks filtered by a regex pattern across multiple benchmark test suites
run_benchmarks_with_custom_jobs: run microbenchmarks using a custom number of parallel CPU jobs for execution
run_benchmarks_without_counters: run microbenchmarks with counters disabled using the no-counters flag
run_benchmarks_with_fewer_loops: run microbenchmarks with fewer loops for faster but noisier benchmark results
